documents.description: Epic parent for Scaffy (charter: .claude/workflows/bp-scaffy-charter.md, masterplan paper /papers/scaffy-commands-as-content). Scaffy = commands as content: declarative, idempotent, reversible .scaffy scaffolding documents that CREATE vertical slices AND inject wiring into accretion files at guarded, MARK-planted anchors, closing with ASSERTs that run the repo's own gates. Wave 1 (2026-07-16): 7-command corpus + scaffy/README.md + the show-off showcase paper (scaffy-command-showcase) + masterplan .nextgen->.scaffy patch — no engine, deliberately. Wave 2: bp scaffy validate/fmt (grammar as code, W1 corpus = fixtures). Wave 3: engine run/remove with receipts. Wave 4: command document type + catalog. North star: bp add block-type --var BlockName=timeline -> 30s -> a new block rendering everywhere, parity at birth.

purpose.why: The larger automation platform goal requires grammar, fixtures, execution, rollback, and discovery to mature as one coherent capability. hand-authored scaffolding knowledge was scattered, unvalidated, non-reversible, and unavailable to connected Barkpark clients. Sequencing corpus, validator, engine, receipts, document type, and remote pull in four evidence-gated waves was the right intervention because each layer uses the previous layer as its fixtures and safety contract, preventing an ungrounded general-purpose generator. If omitted, automation remains local folklore or becomes a high-blast-radius text mutator with no provenance and no rollback.
